info.name: Collections Service - Dunning & Delinquency (Admin)
info.description:
Admin-configurable, multi-tenant collections configuration for the Collections Service.

## Folders
1. **Dunning Policies** — DPD-stage policies (PRE_DUE → WRITE_OFF) with late-fee, Simah, and stage-action JSON. Resolution chain: product-specific → tenant default → built-in.
2. **Delinquency Rules** — Per-product, per-stage rules mirroring the LMS admin UI (6 lifecycle types: 1=Early Settlement, 2=Due Loan, 3=Late Payment, 4=Write-offs, 5=Non-Performing Loan, 6=Broken Promises). Type=1 also owns child early-settlement configs (singles + ranges).

Every payment completion triggers `DelinquencyEngine.tickAndAssess(...)` — advances installment stages using the resolved grace-period and emits a DelinquencyAssessment event (Simah reporting, agent assignment, wallet freeze, charity-fund late fee).

Auth: Bearer {{accessToken}} from identity-service login.
Role required: `collections_head`, `admin`, or `super_admin` for writes. `product_admin`, `compliance_officer`, `head_of_accounts`, `underwriter`, `collections_agent` get read.

Kong route: {{kongUrl}}/collections-service/api/v1/admin/...

item.name: Dunning Policies
item.description: Admin-configurable, product-wise DPD-stage policies (PRE_DUE → WRITE_OFF). Used by `DunningPolicyResolver` to drive the dynamic dunning flow on every payment tick.

Casbin: `dunning.policies:read`

request.description:
Creates the tenant-wide default policy. Applied to ANY loan whose productCode has no policy bound.

**Thresholds** (DPD buckets):
- PRE_DUE: 3 days before due
- GRACE: 1–10 DPD
- SOFT: 11–30 DPD
- HARD: 31–90 DPD
- LEGAL: 91–180 DPD
- WRITE_OFF: ≥ 181 DPD

**Sharia**: late fee swept to `charityFundAccount`, NOT revenue.

Casbin: `dunning.policies:create`

item.name: 10. Simulate — No Product Match (tenant default fallback)

request.description:
Dry-run: with no productCode, the resolver uses the tenant default. Response shows resolved stage, late fee, Simah flags, and agent/wallet flags for an outstanding balance of SAR 5,000 at DPD=45.

Expected: stage=HARD_COLLECTION, lateFee ≈ outstanding × 1.5% (capped at maxAmount), simahReport=false (reportDpd=60), assignAgent=true (agentAssignmentDpd=31).

Casbin: `dunning.policies:read`
With product-specific policy active for `{{productCode}}`: policySource=PRODUCT_SPECIFIC, stage=LEGAL (legalDpd=61 for strict policy), simahReport=true, simahDefaultFlag=true, freezeWallet=true.

Change `dpd` to walk the stages:
- dpd = -3 → PRE_DUE_REMINDER (3 days before due)
- dpd = 0  → DUE_DATE_REMINDER
- dpd = 5  → GRACE_PERIOD (< gracePeriodDays=10)
- dpd = 15 → SOFT_COLLECTION
- dpd = 45 → HARD_COLLECTION
- dpd = 100 → LEGAL
- dpd = 200 → WRITE_OFF

Hard-delete. Prefer `deactivate` (#8) to preserve audit history.

Casbin: `dunning.policies:delete`

item.name: Delinquency Rules
item.description:
Per-product delinquency rules — one row per `(tenant, product, delinquencyType)` tuple. Mirrors the LMS admin UI's six tabs.

**Single atomic PUT** — the rule AND its early-settlement configs are sent together in one request. The server replaces the complete config set on every upsert (rewrite-on-save).

**Wire codes for `delinquencyType`:**
- 1 = `EARLY_SETTLEMENT` (embed `configs[]` with `isCustom=true`)
- 2 = `DUE_LOAN`
- 3 = `LATE_PAYMENT`
- 4 = `WRITE_OFFS`
- 5 = `NON_PERFORMING_LOAN`
- 6 = `BROKEN_PROMISES` (uses `promisesPerYear` / `promisesPerLoan`; `penaltyType` defaults to 0 = N/A)

**`configs[]` item** (only valid for `EARLY_SETTLEMENT` + `isCustom=true`):
- `kind`: `SINGLE` or `RANGE`
- SINGLE requires `invoiceOrder`
- RANGE requires `rangeNo`, `minInvoiceOrder`, `maxInvoiceOrder`
- All items require `isPercentage`, `fromDay`, `tillDay` (+ `discountPercentage` or `discountAmount`)

**Sharia**: any monetary `penaltyAmount` / `penaltyPercentage` for late payment must route to `charityFundAccount`, never to revenue.

Casbin object: `delinquency.rules` (actions: `manage`, `read`, `delete`).

item.name: 1. Upsert Rule — Early Settlement (type=1, flat discount, isCustom=false)

request.description:
Flat discount mode. `isCustom=false` → the rule uses the top-level `penaltyPercentage`/`penaltyAmount` + day range; `configs[]` must be empty or omitted.

Casbin: `delinquency.rules:manage`

item.name: 2. Upsert Rule — Early Settlement (type=1, custom frequency, full configs atomic)

exec: pm.test('6 configs persisted (1 single + 5 range rows)', () => pm.expect(body.earlySettlementConfigs).to.have.lengthOf(6));

request.description:
Custom-frequency mode. `isCustom=true` with the full `configs[]` array in ONE request.

- The RANGE item (invoices 2–6) expands server-side into 5 rows (`isRange=true`, `rangeNo=1`, `min=2`, `max=6`).
- The SINGLE item (invoice 1) becomes 1 row (`isRange=false`, `rangeNo=0`).
- Every upsert **replaces** the entire config set for this rule (rewrite-on-save). Omit `configs[]` to clear all configs.

Server returns 422 if `isCustom=false` and `configs[]` is non-empty.
DUE_LOAN configures the bank's posture on the due date itself (typically zero penalty, just the stage marker). Adjust `tillDay` to define the grace before LATE_PAYMENT kicks in.

item.name: 4. Upsert Rule — Late Payment (type=3, % penalty to charity)

request.description: Late payment penalty 2% of the overdue installment, applied 1–30 DPD. Sharia-compliant: the collected amount routes to `charityFundAccount`, NOT to revenue.
Write-off threshold at 181+ DPD (matches the standard SAMA prudential charge-off window).
NPL bucket — typically 90–180 DPD per SAMA classification. No additional penalty (already accruing under LATE_PAYMENT) — this rule just marks the stage.
Broken Promises tracker — caps the customer at 6 promise-to-pay arrangements per year and 3 per loan. `penaltyType=0` (N/A — this is a behavioural cap, not a fee).

Fetch one rule. For EARLY_SETTLEMENT rules, the response includes the `earlySettlementConfigs` array (singles + ranges) attached during hydration.

Casbin: `delinquency.rules:read`

item.name: 9. List Rules for a Product (all 6 stages)

request.description:
Returns every rule (active + soft-deleted) for the product, one per `delinquencyType`. Useful for the LMS admin UI's tabbed view.

Casbin: `delinquency.rules:read`

Sets `record_state=0`. The unique active-rule index `(tenant, product, type) WHERE record_state=1` is then free, so a fresh `PUT` can install a replacement rule for the same triplet.

Emits `DelinquencyRuleDeactivated` event. Prefer this over a hard delete to preserve audit history.

Casbin: `delinquency.rules:delete`
